candidate: Rae et al. (2020), Dynamic Compressive Strength and Fragmentation in Felsic Crystalline Rocks
reference_measure: logarithmic sieve diameter: log-orthopolic mass allocation, not per-fragment mass or linear-orthopolic allocation
budget_provenance: ST2 F is Calculated Sample Mass (g), formula references D sample length and E diameter; material density is separately characterized by helium pycnometry. No individually weighed pre-fragmentation mass, geometric tolerance, or weighing precision established in inspected methods. V is Mass Recovered (g); W computes recovery from V/F.
outcome_representation: Eight per-bin percentages in X:AE, units % in row2, including two open tails. Stored numeric values are not formula expressions. Their initial-versus-recovered-mass denominator is unresolved from header/method inspection.
controls: ST2 C is P (bar); strain rate and its uncertainty are L/M, obtained from bar strain gauges, not from fragment profile. Repeated IDs are material-specific experiment identifiers, not a separate replicate identifier.
quasistatic_limitation: ST1 has mechanical summaries only, no fragment allocation columns, so does not support a QS-to-dynamic fragment-profile transfer.
eligible_scope: Promising conditional recovered-profile test or a nominal geometry-density-budget sensitivity analysis; not qualified as an independently weighed complete-budget absolute allocation forecast.
proposed_numeric_qualification: Before any numeric release, fix mutually exclusive closure rules for percentages summing to recovered total versus initial-mass recovery, or carry both interpretations conservatively. Retain unmatched/ambiguous rows. Bound missing material adversarially; do not infer its size distribution from discrepancies.
statistical_scope: Whole experiments, not sibling fragments, are observation units. Published sample loss depends on strain rate; no iid or missing-at-random assumption justified. No instrument covariance/distribution established.
exposure: Methods text, header labels, experiment ID strings and lithology labels, formula reference lineage, source metadata and published numerical summaries were read. Published recovery range82.2–97.8%, mean93.4%; finesbelow0.2mm at most10.1%; published aggregate strain-rate/median/fractal trends appeared in extracted-text snippets. No numerical experimental worksheet outcome values converted or reported; no figures digitized; no per-experiment report PDFs opened.
decision: Archive merits a specifically qualified conditional boundary protocol if parent chooses it. Preserve failure of original complete measured-budget gate; do not call this independent absolute-budget confirmation.
